messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Expectation sync — Staff Serving Eng: role scope, scoring anchors & debrief ownership

Team — looping you in on the Staff Serving Engineer candidate (Sarah Nguyen). Recruiter sent the resume and wants us to move to onsite loop next week. Before we schedule, I want a short calibration so interviewers are aligned on:

- Role scope and must-have vs nice-to-have (owner of model-serving runtime + infra improvements)
- Leveling anchors for Staff vs Senior (impact, ambiguity, cross-team leadership)
- Interview focus areas per slot: systems design, inference optimizations, coding exercise, behavioral/depth on tradeoffs
- Debrief cadence + who owns the hire/no-hire recommendation and score normalization

Attachments: resume_sarah_nguyen.pdf, evaluation-template.xlsx (light rubric). Also a quick MAP here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aB2cDEF-example-MAP-plan

Asks: please reply with (1) any adjustments to the role scope, (2) which slot you want to own in the loop, and (3) whether you can join a 30-min sync tomorrow or Thursday. I can host and will capture a short scoring anchor doc (and merge into evaluation-template).

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Hiring Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expectation sync — Staff Serving Eng: role scope, scoring anchors & debrief ownership

Thanks Neha — quick thoughts inline.

Role scope: agree with owner-of-serving-runtime phrasing. Recommend adding explicit responsibility for "cost/perf tradeoff decisions" (quantization, batching policy, routing fallbacks) as a must-have.

Slots: I can own the behavioral/depth slot (candidate's prior ownership, tradeoff decisions, cross-team influence).

Debrief: propose this cadence — 15 min immediate debrief after loop (quick thumbs + one-sentence rationale) and then a 30-min normalization call 24 hours later if signals conflict. I can take owner of the normalization call.

Availability: free Thursday 11:00–12:00 PT for a 30-min sync. If others prefer tomorrow, I can shift to 4pm.

- Marissa

Subject: Re: Expectation sync — Staff Serving Eng: role scope, scoring anchors & debrief ownership

Neha — forwarding a short doc I use as a bar-raiser anchor for serving roles (attached: leveling-guidance.pdf). High-level scoring anchors I'd like us to align on:

1) Technical ownership & impact (0–4): delivered runtime features that improved p99 or throughput at product scale; expectation at Staff: led cross-team production rollout and measurable unit-cost savings.
2) Ambiguity & architecture judgement (0–4): Staff makes tradeoffs for long-term maintainability and can articulate alternatives + risks.
3) Mentorship & influence (0–4): lifts team through design/code reviews and sets standards.
4) Execution under constraints (0–4): can ship with partial data and unknown kernels.

Scoring guidance: recommend we use the attached evaluation-template.xlsx but normalize by marking any 3+ in anchors (1) or (2) as strong signals for Staff. I'm happy to act as bar-raiser for this loop.

Attachment: leveling-guidance.pdf

-Markus

Quick add — I think we should add a short system-design slot that explicitly covers: kernel selection strategy, caching/KV cache management, and fallback routing policy. I can take that slot but would like one interviewer pairing with me focused on probing for latency SLOs and quantization tradeoffs.

Also—I'm attaching a link to an interview script I used previously that maps 45min->30/15 question splits: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1DesignScriptExample. If we want a small coding task, I suggest a 20-min micro-coding on a hot-path optimization (candidate implements a tight loop and explains complexity).

Thanks all — summary & plan: 

1) Role scope: final phrasing will include "owner of serving runtime and cost/perf tradeoffs" (agreed).
2) Slots assigned: Jonas — system design (kernels, caching, routing); Marissa — behavioral/depth (tradeoffs and leadership); Markus — bar-raiser & normalization owner; Grace — coding exercise (hot-path optimization).
3) Debrief cadence: immediate 15-min thumbs after loop; Markus will convene 30-min normalization the next day if needed.
4) Interview artifacts: use evaluation-template.xlsx (attached) and mark anchors per Markus' guidance.
5) Scheduling: Emily — please send times for onsite loop between Aug 3–6. Interviewers, please block 4–5pm PT on Aug 4 as tentative normalization hold; final will be calendared once Emily confirms availability. Calendly for 30-min sync (if you still want a pre-loop sync): https://calendly.com/neha-kapoor/30min-debrief

Emily: please confirm candidate availability and kick off scheduling. Sarah — thanks for your flexibility; recruiter will follow up with next steps.

Neha
